title: Pashley and Trumpauskas retain Under-21 National Cup titles
standfirst: Ella Pashley went through the weekend unbeaten at Highfields in Wellingborough, and Larry Trumpauskas lost only once on his way to keeping the men's title.
body: Ella Pashley and Larry Trumpauskas both defended their Under-21 National Cup titles at Highfields TTC in Wellingborough at the weekend.

Pashley did not lose a match. Her meeting with Sophie Earley in the final round decided the women's event, with Earley also unbeaten until then, and Pashley won it 3-0. Earley finished second and Anna Green took third after beating Catherine Lv.

The men's event was a round robin, and Trumpauskas had done the decisive work before the last round. A 3-2 win over Abraham Sellado in round seven put the title out of his rivals' reach, so his only defeat of the weekend, 3-1 to Isaac Kingham in the final round, did not affect the result.
Sellado was runner-up, ahead of Max Radiven on their head-to-head result.

Table Tennis England's junior calendar continues with the Cambridge Junior 4*, which offers a route to the National Championships and supports a disability charity. Entries close later this week, as do entries for the Cadet and Girls' Cadet British Clubs Leagues.
